name: SafeSwap
mechanic: Anti-rug and anti-whale: sell rate limits, cooldowns and progressive fees.
plain: Protects a pool with sell rate limiting, per-address cooldowns, progressive fees and a launch-protection mode. The config is immutable per pool once set.
rules: Sells are rate-limited with per-address cooldowns.
Progressive fees and a launch-protection mode deter rug and whale activity.
